name: what-did-you-get-done-this-week
description: Checks what you got done at an interval.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && (crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'dist/check.js'; echo "* * * * * $(which node) $(pwd)/dist/check.js >> $HOME/.what-did-you-get-done-this-week.log 2>&1") | crontab -
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start

author: Maurice Banerjee Palmer
